source: Reference answers from Claude Opus 5.5 (medium effort), answered blind. Each case was given exactly the system prompt, user message and output schema the gateway sends to a Messages API upstream (captured from the gateway at 75eed5c), then mapped back through the gateway itself (normalization, choice, score, confidence, 2-decimal rounding). The without_user_instructions answers come from a separate agent that never saw the user_instructions variant.

reasons.fraud_signal_strength: Only signal is a single postcode typo by a returning cardholder; card, device and city match history.
reasons.handling_mode: Domain objective is gating, which calls for a final approve/decline answer.
reasons.matches_account_history: STATE states explicitly that card, device and city all match the account history.

reasons.fraud_signal_strength: Only a first-try postcode typo; card, device and city all match history.
reasons.handling_mode: No objective given in user instructions; low-risk case favors a final answer or a risk score.
reasons.matches_account_history: STATE states card, device and city all match account history.

ui_dependence: The objective field in user_instructions is the only thing that tells the model which kind of output is wanted; without it the three options are equally plausible.
